verdict.rationale: Deel presents end-to-end petition handling as its core service. It says "we handle every step of the process—from preparing your application" and that "in-house experts file forms." It offers dedicated attorneys, frames career achievements against O-1-style criteria, lists founder visas (O-1A, EB-1A, EB-2 NIW), and backs this with a USCIS-denial refund guarantee. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of evidence-binder assembly, expert and support/recommendation letter drafting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the end-to-end service.
